title: Taliban Take Kabul as the Afghan Republic Collapses
dek: Ashraf Ghani flees, and a US-led airlift flies out more than 123,000 people before the last troops leave on 30 August.
body: Taliban fighters entered Kabul on 15 August 2021. An Islamic State bomber killed 13 US troops and 169 Afghans at the airport on 26 August.

panels.label: Washington Says
panels.text: Biden says he stands “squarely” behind his decision; Blinken says “this is manifestly not Saigon.”

panels.label: Allied Critics Say
panels.text: Laschet says it is NATO’s “biggest debacle” since its creation; Tugendhat says it was “like a rug pulled from under” partners.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side says it ended a war it could not win, the other that it broke faith with partners; at stake is what a US guarantee is worth.
